title: Power bound from an accuracy lower bound
statement: Let $n,C,Q,r$ be natural numbers, let $t$ be a positive rational, and let $\varepsilon$ be a rational with $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$. Suppose that $1\le n$, that $1/(Q+1)\le\varepsilon$, and that $t\le (C+1)(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1)$. Then $(1/\varepsilon)^r\le (Q+1)^r$.
